sources.title: ERNIE-4.5-300B-A47B model card
sources.evidence: Identifies post-trained text MoE; nominal 300B total and 47B activated per token; Apache 2.0; 131072 context. PT denotes PyTorch format. Its Pretraining and Vision Experts table rows conflict with the exact-model description and configuration.

sources.title: Announcing the Open Source Release of the ERNIE 4.5 Model Family
sources.evidence: Dated June 30, 2025; announces open weights and Apache 2.0, explicitly names ERNIE-4.5-300B-A47B as the post-trained model.

sources.title: Exact Paddle model configuration
sources.evidence: 54 layers; 8192 hidden size; 64/8 attention heads; 64 experts with top-8 routing; MoE begins at layer index 3; intermediate sizes 28672 dense and 3584 expert; one next-token prediction block; untied embeddings; context 131072.

sources.title: Exact Paddle checkpoint index and indexed safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Read all 123 indexed shard headers via byte ranges: 6864 tensors and 300474051776 elements (300447309824 U16/bfloat16 payload values, 26741952 F32). All are learned weights or learned routing biases; no quantization scales, packed weights or storage-only tensors. MTP contributes 989888512.

sources.title: Auxiliary-loss-free routing-bias update implementation
sources.evidence: Lines 114-126 update e_score_correction_bias from sign(mean expert usage minus observed usage) times update_lr. These 3264 stored biases are learned by non-gradient updates and are included in the complete count.

sources.title: ERNIE 4.5 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Downloaded primary PDF and extracted text after web viewer rejected its size. Table 1 identifies exact model as post-trained, non-multimodal, MoE and non-thinking. Table 2 gives A47B family 54 layers, 64/8 text experts, no shared experts, and 131072 context.

sources.title: AI Studio large-model API capability documentation
sources.evidence: Section 2.6 identifies this exact model in the 2025/6/30 open-model list as text chat, mapped to ernie-4.5-turbo-128k-preview. Its function-call support list omits this model; this service-specific omission does not prove universal impossibility.

sources.title: Exact model chat template
sources.evidence: Template accepts system/user/assistant text messages, with no tools parameter or tool-call message formatting.

sources.title: PyTorch packaging configuration
sources.evidence: Same architecture and one next-token prediction block; explicitly zero shared experts. PT is the post-trained model in PyTorch format, not a pretraining suffix.

sources.title: PyTorch packaging checkpoint index
sources.evidence: 10242 tensors, including 12 MTP tensors; same 601001587456-byte indexed tensor payload as Paddle. Hub safetensors metadata independently reports 300447309824 BF16 and 26741952 F32 elements, confirming identical total across formats.

sources.title: Qianfan model release history
sources.evidence: June 2025 history lists ERNIE-4.5-Turbo-128K-Preview introduced June 25, whereas 0.3B, 21B and VL28B exact open-model names appear June 29. Later alias mapping alone cannot prove June25 endpoint served the released 300B checkpoint.

sources.title: ERNIE open model launch announcement for Qianfan
sources.evidence: Indexed primary announcement, updated July 18 2025, maps ERNIE-4.5-300B-A47B to ernie-4.5-turbo-128k-preview. Direct web fetch timed out; complete indexed model table was available. Does not establish when that alias began serving this exact checkpoint.

sources.title: BaiDu ERNIE 4.5 MoE Model API Now Live on Novita AI
sources.evidence: Provider publication dated June 29 2025 explicitly announces availability, names ERNIE-4.5-300B-A47B and gives exact baidu/ernie-4.5-300b-a47b-paddle API calls. This is primary evidence for its own hosted availability, not used to verify architecture. Broad Agents SDK tool-use marketing conflicts with lack of native developer documentation.

name.note: Readable spelling of exact ERNIE-4.5-300B-A47B post-trained variant; distinct from -Base and -VL.

release_date.note: Earliest verified exact-name hosted availability: Novita June29 announcement and exact Paddle model API example. Baidu open-weight announcement is June30. A June25 Qianfan preview alias was later mapped to this model, but checkpoint identity on June25 is unproven; do not silently transfer that date.

open_weights.note: Official accessible checkpoint and open-release announcement.

parameters_b.note: Exact complete checkpoint: 300474051776 learned scalar values, including 0.989888512B MTP and 3264 non-gradient-learned routing biases. The public 300B figure is rounded. U16 is Paddle bfloat16 payload representation, not packed quantization. Main model excluding MTP is 299.484163264B.

active_parameters_b.note: Official rounded active count per token, not an exact scalar count. Top-8 of 64 routed experts per MoE layer; 3 initial dense FFNs, all attention and routers are also involved. No shared experts. Auxiliary MTP and input-embedding counting conventions are not specified by the reported 47B, so no artificial exact active count is inferred.

architecture.note: Causal Transformer MoE: 3 initial dense layers, then 51 MoE layers with top-8 of 64 experts; zero shared experts; 64 query/8 KV heads. Separate auxiliary dense MTP block. The text checkpoint has no vision encoder or vision experts.

context_window.note: Configured maximum position embeddings and technical report agree.

modalities.note: Exact text checkpoint; multimodal pretraining heritage does not make this the VL release.

reasoning.note: Table 1 explicitly classifies this post-trained model as non-thinking; not a claim that it cannot solve reasoning tasks.

tool_call.note: Native tool calling remains unverified. Baidu service support list omits this model and released template lacks tools formatting. Novita advertises tool use in Agents SDK workflows; this deployment claim does not settle native checkpoint support. Clear unsupported baseline true.

description.value: Baidu post-trained text MoE with approximately 300B parameters and a reported 47B activated per token.
description.note: Adds exact training variant and preserves explicitly approximate parameter wording.

patch.description: Baidu post-trained text MoE with approximately 300B parameters and a reported 47B activated per token.
patch.notes: Complete learned checkpoint count is 300.474051776B including 0.989888512B auxiliary MTP; 300B total and 47B active are published rounded labels. Routing correction biases are included because training updates them. This is the post-trained, non-thinking text variant; PT means PyTorch packaging. Native tool calling is unverified. The model-card table contains conflicting Pretraining and Vision Experts rows; exact configuration and technical report resolve these as post-trained and text-only. Earliest exact-name hosted availability verified June29 on Novita; Baidu announced open weights June30. A June25 Qianfan alias existed, but its checkpoint identity at launch is unresolved.

summary: Corrected release to earliest verified exact-name hosted availability June29, before June30 Baidu open-weight announcement; documented unresolved June25 alias identity. Confirmed Apache-2.0, text-only non-thinking post-trained identity, context, and top-8/64 MoE with no shared experts. Replaced rounded 300B with exact 300.474051776B learned checkpoint count from every shard header, including MTP and learned routing biases; retained official rounded 47B active. Cleared unverified native tool calling. Card table conflicts documented.
